sourceRecords.title: China Mingyang Unveils Plans for Massive 50 MW Floating Wind Turbine
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that Mingyang Smart Energy unveiled plans for a 50 MW floating offshore wind turbine using two 25 MW main engines on a V-shaped tower, similar to the Ocean-X platform. The source states that the design is planned for deep waters and twin 290-metre rotors.

briefingItems.title: Mingyang outlines 50 MW floating turbine concept
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: Mingyang announced plans for a 50 MW twin-head floating offshore wind turbine.
briefingItems.explanation: The source describes a large floating turbine concept and its basic architecture rather than an installed project.
